subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should PR #14432 be consolidated into the existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or should maintainers intentionally change nested sub-agent policy?
rationale: The correct answer depends on maintainer prompt-policy direction because current main already has several guidance surfaces and supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only non-duplicative examples and merge them into existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime/config/docs/tests and Codex-facing policy together instead of prompt text alone.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: Close or pause this branch if current main's merged guidance is sufficient and no unique prompt wording is desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only non-duplicative examples and merge them into existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame places the prompt and sub-agent guidance surfaces under recent work by this owner candidate.
